scenario: `emit X logical` correctness depends on the no-op reassertion discipline per LLOG.6.1. Logical schema slots may carry `tolerance` per LFAC.2.6.4 — within-tolerance reassertions are suppressed so derived logical facts don't flicker. Pin: a logical schema with a tolerance-annotated slot compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Temp scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time
    celsius: Float mutable tolerance 0.5

schema TempAlert scope logical:
    source: String key

rule alert_hot:
    Temp t where t.celsius > 30.0
->
    emit TempAlert logical source: "temp_sensor"
